text: If a tool offers to write articles from your changelog, ask who decides how much of a change may be said in public. Ask whether the same change judged twice gives the same answer. Ask whether a commit message can be copied onto your site as it stands. Ask what you see when the tool decides a change is not worth an article. Ask whether a topic you turned down will come back next week. Ask which sources a draft may quote, and whether an engineer's own wording can slip into the published text. Ask who signs off before anything reaches your website, and where that sign-off is recorded.
